title: Planet Tweaks V3.0.6 NOVA TITAN - Headphone Studio Fix, Instant 0ms Macro Capture & All-Category Expansion

(3) CPU Performance Tab Laptop Unlock: Unlocked all 20 elite CPU scheduling, parking, and AC power plan tweaks for both Laptops and Desktops. (4) Mass Category Expansion: Expanded all lighter categories to 15-20+ verified kernel tweaks across Cloud Gaming/GFN (16 tweaks), Potato/Max FPS (18 tweaks), Game Booster (18 tweaks), Storage (17 tweaks), and Privacy & Safety (18 tweaks). (5) GeForce NOW 2.0.90 Delay Elimination: Neutralized heavy CEF Mica/Acrylic backdrop filters and injected zero-delay streaming flags into sharedstorage.json.
